title: Template:Box1 start/doc
content:
;Description :This template starts a blue box, as the first part of a two column box. ;Syntax :Type {{t|Box1 start}}, then whatever you would like inside the first box, then {{t|Box2 start}} and whatever you want in the second box, ended by {{t|Boxes end}}. :For example... 
{{Box1 start}}
Text
{{Box2 start}}
Text
{{Boxes end}}
